review.scope: Pending independent exact-head review of the three-commit replay over merged PR #618.

notes: New clients upload to the private chat-attachments-private bucket and register through quata_chat_register_attachment_v2. Android and Web derive 300-second signed URLs in memory; iOS downloads through the authenticated Storage route with its bearer token.

Web degrades a missing, malformed or unsignable private attachment to an unavailable attachment without exposing its stored URL or suppressing sibling messages; coroutine cancellation still propagates.
The public chat-attachments bucket remains only for the distinguishable Android v32 compatibility lane and can be retired independently when those clients are gone.

A departed uploader cannot read a linked private object, an active remaining participant can read it, and deleted conversation state denies it. The disposable database probe also verified DELETE policy behavior; production itself forbids direct deletion from storage tables and requires the Storage API.
The encrypted full logical backup and focal restore drill prove database metadata recovery. They do not claim backup or recovery of Storage object bytes.

The historical audit found 409 attachment rows, including 350 references whose Storage object is absent; 343 are linked and 7 are unlinked. This pre-existing inconsistency was not silently backfilled.
Migration 20261011110000 committed atomically from the exact Product SHA. General postflight passed, and the postdeploy visibility probe rolled back all synthetic mutations with zero residue.
No full E2E matrix was repeated solely for SHA identity; final GitHub jobs provide clean-runner recertification.
The checked-in report is sanitized and contains no credential, connection string, actor/conversation identifier, backup key or private path.
